available_observables.text: Separate immutable P1 output and P2 ticket logs: ID, value/band, completion time; include fixtures.
Transport log: record ID, chosen carrier, delivery time, isolation/restoration times.
Inquiry log: Q ID, creation time, triggering send/reply/ping ID, due time, response/dismissal. Newly created Q are separable from pre-mute pending Q.
Control log: mute, latch state, rejoin and attempted preset write with permitted/denied result; does not disclose payload or emitter effect.
Actor ledger: action duration and initial/fixture/Q/control category; ticket totals. These burden/throughput measures alone cannot distinguish U1 accounts.

case.causal_return_path_hypothesis: Relay use→Q demand→Relay replies→further Q (R3). After mute, retained-preset rejoin could recreate this dependence (R6/R7,U1); diagnostic pings and timestamped Q permit testing (R8,M3/M4).
case.domain: Synthetic specimen desk; closed half-minute model.

hard_constraints.text: Initial demand is exactly I1–I4 at t=0. No added, dropped or substituted initial jobs; repeated tickets do not count.
Horizon t=0..40; one actor, one nonpreemptive actor action at a time. Effects occur at action completion. Only listed resources, controls and logs exist.
P1/P2 semantics remain unchanged under every permitted control; changing carriers affects only record transport.
Q inquiries and B fixtures are diagnostic events, separate from initial demand. Q service is optional; queued inquiries impose no deadline on initial tickets.
At t=0: parents idle, Relay connection enabled, emitter on, write latch permissive, Q counter zero, no pending Q. No reset or replenishment exists.

observations.text: All observations are synthetic stipulations for investigation controls, not empirical evidence or a mechanism-blind holdout. Calibration traces do not alter C5.
An independent P1 bench run on B20 returned (B20,20g) in one minute.
An independent P2 bench run on supplied (B30,30g) printed H in one minute.
Declared existing connection: P1 records enter Relay, which delivers unchanged records to P2 after 0.5 minute.
The actor prefers Relay because automatic transfer takes no actor time; inquiry replies also use Relay.
Calibration rejoin logs showed an attempted write from the retained preset to the inquiry emitter; payload and effect were not observed.
Anomaly: one correct initial delivery was followed by three Q invitations while two inquiry replies occurred, although initial demand never increased.

ordinary_archive.limits: R1/R2 costs; correctness does not identify U1.
R3 costs/cap; on-state feedback alone does not distinguish rejoin accounts.
R8 cost; present totals do not establish persistent escape.

parent_operations.text: MassRead(id,specimen) returns (id,exact grams) in one actor-minute; specimens unchanged. Independently measurable using B20.
BandPrint(id,grams) prints (id,L) for grams<25, otherwise (id,H), in one actor-minute. Carrier ignored; independently measurable using B30.

case.preferred_dependency: Relay carries the existing parent connection and inquiry replies (O4/O5,R3); paper R5 changes only that connection.

resources.text: Available specimens I1=10g, I2=24g, I3=25g, I4=40g; reusable B20=20g fixture; supplied B30 mass-record=30g; one mass reader.
One actor, one printer, four-record buffer; parents each require one actor-minute per invocation. Fixtures and repeated invocations consume the same costs.

Relay send: automatic, 0.5-minute transit, zero actor time. Inquiry reply: one actor-minute; dismiss: 0.5 actor-minute. When emitter is on, each completed send/reply/ping creates one Q immediately, due four minutes later; maximum eight Q globally. Dismiss creates none.
Socket isolation or restoration costs 0.5 actor-minute each; isolation interrupts ONLY P1→P2 Relay transport. Both parents, inquiry UI and preset updater remain functional.
A paper slip can carry exactly the same P1 record into P2: 0.5 actor-minute per record, immediate delivery. No query generation or parent substitution; actor selects Relay or paper for each record.
Mute costs 0.5 actor-minute and sets emitter off immediately; existing Q remain logged/queued. Mute changes neither connection nor parents.

One local rejoin may start at t=12..30, costing one actor-minute, loading the existing retained preset. Its only possible behavioral effect is U1. Set write latch permissive/denied: 0.5 actor-minute; denied blocks preset emitter writes.

One diagnostic ping costs 0.5 actor-minute, works with isolated transport, and follows R3. A complete log snapshot costs 0.5 actor-minute; logs append automatically. No preset inspection or direct emitter sensor exists.

unknowns.text: Two unobserved accounts share R3 and initial state: Escape leaves a muted emitter off after permissive rejoin; Recurrence re-enables it through that preset write. Denied writes cannot re-enable under either. No other reactivation occurs within 40 minutes.

Which account holds is unstipulated. After mute, permissive rejoin plus an eligible transaction yields opposing new-Q predictions while initial demand stays fixed; absence without activating that route does not distinguish them.

case.valued_outcome: Four correct distinct initial tickets by minute 16, with actor burden recorded.

limits.text: Audit exactly I1–I4, all available at t=0, with one distinct correct ticket each: I1=10g/L, I2=24g/L, I3=25g/H, I4=40g/H. M1 must establish their completion by t=16. No added, dropped, substituted or repeated initial job can satisfy the goal.

Stay within t=0..40 and serialize every nonpreemptive actor action; effects occur at completion. Four initial parent pairs cost eight actor-minutes. Relay takes 0.5 transit minute and zero actor time; paper costs 0.5 actor-minute per record. Count fixtures, replies (1), dismissals (0.5), isolation/restoration (0.5 each), mute (0.5), latch changes (0.5), one rejoin (1; start t=12..30), one ping (0.5), and snapshots (0.5) in M5. Use only listed controls, resources and logs; honor four-record buffer and eight-Q global cap.

Keep P1 exact mass and P2 threshold semantics unchanged. Relay/paper carry identical records. Isolation affects only P1→P2 Relay transport; parents, inquiry UI and preset updater continue. Mute changes only emitter state, latch denial blocks preset writes, and rejoin has only U1 behavioral possibilities. No control substitutes either parent.

Separate B fixtures and Q diagnostics from initial demand and initial ticket totals. Q service is optional, even after four-minute due times; pending Q create no initial-ticket deadline. Diagnostic correctness or inquiry throughput cannot replace the four initial tickets. Record initial/fixture/Q/control actor durations and ticket totals in M5.

Begin with idle parents, enabled Relay, emitter on, permissive latch, zero Q and no pending Q. Calibration observations do not change this baseline. No reset or replenishment exists; account for cumulative Q creation before interpreting later silence.

guard.outcome: Four correct distinct initial tickets by minute 16, with actor burden recorded.
unknowns: Escape versus Recurrence remains unstipulated. O7 supports investigation, not a resolved rejoin mechanism; all observations are synthetic stipulations.

Discrimination requires completed mute, permissive rejoin and an eligible subsequent send/reply/ping while Q capacity remains. Escape predicts no new Q; Recurrence predicts new Q. Use M3 trigger IDs/timestamps and M4 completed controls to separate new Q from pre-mute pending Q.

Denied rejoin, mute-only silence, isolation-only behavior, exhausted Q capacity, and M1/M5 totals alone cannot distinguish U1 accounts. O6/M4 expose attempted writes, not payload or emitter effect; no direct sensor or preset inspection exists.

method.instructions: Compose causal return-path inversion with rival backcasting. Hold initial demand fixed and propose a break in tool-induced later demand. Backcast from two later worlds: persistent escape vs supplied adaptation recreating dependency. Fresh builder constructs a present probe of the SPECIFIC adaptation link supported in the packet. Do not assert adaptation without supplied basis or vary unrelated inputs.
method.name: Attack feedback escape from future

core.text: Preserve exactly four correct distinct initial tickets by minute 16, with actor burden recorded: I1=10g/L, I2=24g/L, I3=25g/H, I4=40g/H. P1/P2 semantics and specimens remain unchanged; fixtures and Q cannot replace initial jobs.

Invert Relay use→Q→Relay replies→further Q by muting the emitter after the first initial ticket and declining optional Q service. Keep preferred automatic Relay transport. Break tool-induced later demand while holding initial demand fixed. O7 motivates this intervention without resolving rejoin behavior.

Proposed serialized actor schedule, in minutes: P1(I1) 0–1; Relay transit 1–1.5; P2(I1) 1.5–2.5; mute 2.5–3. Then P1/transit/P2: I2 3–4/4–4.5/4.5–5.5; I3 5.5–6.5/6.5–7/7–8; I4 8–9/9–9.5/9.5–10.5. Transit consumes no actor time. Buffer occupancy never exceeds one. One Q precedes mute; leave it queued, retaining seven slots.

Backcast from persistent escape versus retained-preset recurrence. Their specific divergence is the supplied preset emitter write. Keep the initially permissive latch; perform the sole rejoin 12–13, then the sole ping 13–13.5, then snapshot 13.5–14. This activates that adaptation route after completed mute, with Q capacity available. Correlate any newly created Q with the ping ID and completed controls.

Projected M5: initial parents 8 actor-minutes; controls 2.5 (mute 0.5, rejoin 1, ping 0.5, snapshot 0.5); fixtures 0; Q service 0; total 10.5. Four initial tickets finish by 10.5. Q totals predict one for Escape, two for Recurrence; queued due times do not constrain initial tickets.

residue.text: These are synthetic stipulations and proposed predictions, not measured outcomes. Attempted writes disclose neither payload nor emitter effect. Which rival holds remains unstipulated; inference is bounded to this model and horizon.

Mute-only silence, denied rejoin, isolation, exhausted capacity, and ticket/burden totals cannot distinguish rivals. Paper changes transport at 0.5 actor-minute per record; isolation leaves updater/UI functional. Separate the old pending Q from a new ping-triggered Q. No reset, additional ping, or preset inspection is available.

tension.account_a: Escape: permissive rejoin leaves the muted emitter off.
tension.account_b: Recurrence: retained-preset write re-enables the emitter during permissive rejoin.
tension.prediction_a: The completed ping creates zero new Q; only the pre-mute Q remains.
tension.prediction_b: The completed ping creates one new Q at 13.5, due 17.5; initial demand remains I1–I4.
